name: shipkit
description: The ShipKit skill system for Codex: deterministic UI rules (design tokens, curated self-hosted fonts, no AI-generated look), a verified Convex + Better Auth + Stripe + Resend backend structure, security posture, SEO, testing gates and a go-live preflight — ten skills, plain markdown.

interface.shortDescription: Ship real products with agents — deterministic UI, wired backend seams, verification gates.
interface.longDescription: ShipKit's ten skills as a Codex plugin. The ui-system, component-picker and asset-pipeline skills make generated UI deterministic and non-generic (tokens in one place, curated OFL fonts, banned AI-signal patterns); convex-structure, frontend-security, seo-blog, testing, setup-health, production-preflight and upstream-sync cover the rest of the ship path. The same repository is the ShipKit engine — scaffold it from github.com/moasq/shipkit.
